name: Sublium: Smarter Subscriptions for WooCommerce
author: FunnelKit

sections.description:
Sublium offers the easiest way to sell subscriptions on WooCommerce, reduce churn, and track metrics without any technical complexity. You can sell physical products, digital subscriptions, services, and installment plans on repeat.

Forget clunky, outdated tools that don’t work well together. Sublium gives you everything you need to start, manage, and grow your subscription business in one place.

Sublium has built-in retention tools that help you keep subscribers longer by enabling pause/skip options, smart cancellation flows, and automated payment recovery that retries failed charges.

Sublium Pro

Sublium Pro comes with all the advanced features you need to maximize subscription revenue, including zero transaction fees, a built-in analytics dashboard, smart cancellation flows, a one-click card updater, upgrade groups, and a visual email builder. Get Sublium Pro now!

Watch this video to learn why smart WooCommerce store owners, marketers, developers, and subscription businesses love Sublium:

What Makes Sublium Better than Other WooCommerce Subscription Plugins

Most WooCommerce subscription plugins stop at billing. Sublium goes further into built-in retention, recovery, and revenue optimization.

Explore the features that give you a real competitive advantage.

  • 5-Minute Setup Wizard

Launch your first subscription product in 5 minutes with our guided setup wizard. No complex configuration or technical knowledge required.

  • Easy to Use

No complex setup or technical configuration required. If you can create a standard WooCommerce product, you can create and manage subscriptions just as easily.

  • Flexible Subscription Models

Support for physical Subscribe & Save products, digital memberships, service retainers, and installment payment plans.

  • Zero-Code Simplicity

Sublium is a true no-code subscription solution. Create and manage subscriptions like a pro without custom codes or technical skills.

  • Smart Payment Recovery

Automatically retry failed payments with intelligent scheduling. Send proactive card expiry alerts and let customers update cards with one click, no login required.

  • Built-in Churn Reduction

Let subscribers pause, skip, or reschedule plans themselves. Smart cancellation flows with surveys and automated win-back offers effectively reduce churn.

  • Customer Self-Service Portal

Reduce support tickets by letting subscribers manage their own subscriptions. They can pause, skip deliveries, update shipping, restart canceled plans, and upgrade/downgrade tiers.

  • Built-in Analytics Dashboard

Stop guessing and start growing with real-time dashboards showing MRR, ARR, churn, subscriber trends, cohort performance, and revenue forecasts to make data-driven decisions.

  • Upgrade and Downgrade Offers

Create tier hierarchies (Silver → Gold → Platinum), offer upgrade incentives, handle complex proration automatically, and trigger intelligent upgrade prompts.

  • One-Click Card Updater

Recover revenue lost to expired cards with secure one-time update links. Customers can update payment methods without logging in.

  • Visual Email Builder

Design professional, mobile-friendly subscription emails with the drag-and-drop builder. Personalize your messages with dynamic merge tags.

Exclusive Game-Changing Features

  • Subscribe & Save for Physical Products

Offer automatic deliveries for consumables, let customers choose flexible delivery cycles, boost loyalty with subscriber discounts, and forecast inventory using renewal data.

  • Recurring Digital Subscriptions

Automate billing for memberships, courses, and services. Restrict premium content behind recurring payments and automatically revoke access when payments fail.

  • Installment Payment Plans

Split high-ticket purchases into bite-sized weekly or monthly payments. Collect upfront down payments, allow early payoff, and reduce cart abandonment.

  • Flexible Billing Options

Set custom billing intervals (daily, weekly, monthly, or annually), and define fixed-term or unlimited subscriptions that continue until the user cancels.

  • Offer Free Trials

Let customers experience your product before committing. Offer free trial periods on subscriptions with full control over trial length, billing start date, and post-trial renewals.

  • Charge One-Time Signup Fees

Charge a one-time signup or onboarding fee in addition to recurring subscription payments. Perfect for setup costs, consultations, activation fees, etc.

  • Advanced Subscription Coupons

Apply recurring percentage or fixed discounts, combine with usage limits and expiry dates, and run time-limited promotions.

  • Powerful Payment Gateway Support

Accept payments via Stripe (automatic renewals), Square, PayPal, all major credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay with PCI-compliant tokenization.

  • Automated Email Notifications

Send welcome emails, renewal receipts, cancellation confirmations, installment notifications, and admin alerts for all key events.

  • Smart Cancellation Flows

Present benefit reminders before cancellation, collect feedback via surveys, trigger automated retention offers (discounts, pause, skip, downgrade), and display final win-back offers.

  • Comprehensive Activity Logs

Track every subscription status change, monitor renewal processing, identify event triggers, view precise timestamps, filter by subscription/customer, and CSV export for external auditing.

  • Lightweight and Blazing Fast

Even with powerful features, Sublium loads quickly and keeps your WooCommerce store fast.

  • Auto-Calculated Proration

Automatic fair billing when customers upgrade their subscriptions mid-cycle.

  • No Subscription Limits

Create unlimited subscriptions, accept unlimited subscribers, and generate unlimited recurring revenue.

Integrations

  • FunnelKit Funnel Builder: Sell subscriptions through high-converting checkout pages and sales funnels, and offer recurring products as one-click upsells or order bumps.

  • FunnelKit Automations: Run marketing workflows based on subscription data, automatically tag subscribers, trigger welcome sequences, and launch cart recovery campaigns.

  • LearnDash: Link subscriptions to LMS content, auto-enroll students, and revoke access when payments fail.

  • TutorLMS: Connect course access to recurring billing.

  • MemberPress: Use Sublium for billing while MemberPress manages content protection.

  • WooCommerce Memberships: Automatically grant membership status when a subscription is purchased.

  • AffiliateWP: Reward affiliates for renewals and automatically track recurring commissions.

  • WPML: Fully compatible with WPML for multilingual WooCommerce subscription stores.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Sublium”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the Sublium plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. After installation, click “Activate Plugin”

After Activation

  1. Navigate to Sublium > Settings
  2. Configure your subscription settings
  3. Connect your payment gateway (Stripe, Square, or PayPal)
  4. Create your first subscription product
  5. Start accepting recurring payments!
sections.faq:
What is Sublium and how does it work?

Sublium is a complete WooCommerce subscription management plugin that lets you sell and manage recurring products with ease. You can turn any WooCommerce product into a subscription, automate renewals, manage customers, and track performance from your dashboard.

Do I need coding skills to use Sublium?

No. Sublium is built for store owners, not developers. If you can create a WooCommerce product, you can create a subscription using simple settings and visual controls.

Does Sublium handle failed payments automatically?

Yes. Sublium includes built-in dunning management that automatically retries failed payments, sends reminder emails, and lets you control retry schedules and timing.

How are subscription upgrades and downgrades handled?

Sublium makes plan changes seamless. This WooCommerce subscription plugin automatically prorates charges when customers upgrade or downgrade, ensuring fair billing.

Will Sublium work with my WordPress theme?

Yes! Sublium is built to strict WooCommerce standards and templates, so it works smoothly with almost all themes, including Astra, Divi, Kadence, OceanWP, Hello Elementor, and more.

Do I need Sublium Pro?

Sublium Lite contains everything you need to start selling subscriptions and collecting recurring payments in WooCommerce. However, Sublium Pro is designed to help you scale your business.

You should consider upgrading to Pro if you want to remove the additional transaction fee, access advanced retention tools to stop churn, customize your emails with the visual builder, or unlock deep analytics to track your growth.

Can I sell both subscriptions and regular products together?

Yes, customers can buy subscriptions and regular products in the same WooCommerce checkout.

Will Sublium slow down my website?

No. Sublium is optimized for performance, with lightweight code (<2 MB plugin size), minimal database queries, and efficient cron processing.

Does Sublium support variable products and multiple plans?

Yes. You can create variable subscription products and offer multiple plans (monthly, quarterly, yearly) with different prices.

Does Sublium work with WPML for multilingual stores?

Yes! Sublium is fully compatible with WPML for creating WooCommerce subscription products in multiple languages.

Are there limits on subscriptions or subscribers?

No limits! You can create unlimited subscriptions, accept unlimited subscribers, and generate unlimited recurring revenue to scale without restrictions.

Is Sublium GDPR compliant?

Yes! Sublium follows GDPR best practices, supports data export and deletion requests, and respects customer privacy.

What reports can I generate?

Sublium provides reports for revenue, subscriber growth, churn analysis, payment success rates, subscription status distribution, MRR/ARR trends, and more. All exportable to CSV.

How does Sublium handle taxes?

Sublium integrates with WooCommerce’s tax system to automatically calculate taxes for subscriptions and renewals based on your rules.

Need help setting things up?

Our Support Team is always ready to help you get your subscription business up and running smoothly.
